_about: Facts no vault holds, for the public demo at /demo only: connection status and accounts, scope wording, Slack delivery toggles and the channels the bot can post to, the dates the workspace was set up, the ids a click would create and the issue bodies of the waiting proposals, and the role, zone and account suggestions a model would make for an unprofiled name. Read by scripts/build.js and nothing else; the signed-in workspace (/app) never reads it. Everything derivable from the vault is computed by lib/vault.js instead.
